title: My Big Family
english: It is Friday morning, and Hassan's grandfather is slowly getting ready for the mosque. He is quite old now, and after a long career and a lifetime of raising a large family, simple things take him more time than before.
Hassan sits down and helps him find his shoes near the door. He also carries his grandfather's prayer mat and his small bag. "Thank you, my boy, you are very kind to me," the grandfather says warmly.

They walk to the mosque together, slowly and calmly, talking about old memories along the way. Hassan feels proud that he can support someone who spent decades supporting the rest of the family without ever asking for anything back.

After the prayer, they sit outside for a while, watching people pass by. Hassan realizes that this quiet Friday routine, repeated for years, is exactly what holds a big family together across different generations.
indonesian: Ini pagi hari Jumat, dan kakek Hassan sedang perlahan bersiap-siap ke masjid. Ia sudah cukup tua sekarang, dan setelah karier panjang serta seumur hidup membesarkan keluarga besar, hal-hal sederhana membutuhkan waktu lebih lama dari sebelumnya.
Hassan duduk dan membantunya mencari sandal di dekat pintu. Ia juga membawakan sajadah kakeknya dan tas kecilnya. "Terima kasih, cucuku, kau sangat baik kepadaku," kata sang kakek dengan hangat.

Mereka berjalan ke masjid bersama, perlahan dan tenang, sambil membicarakan kenangan lama di sepanjang jalan. Hassan merasa bangga bisa mendukung seseorang yang telah puluhan tahun mendukung seluruh keluarga tanpa pernah meminta imbalan apa pun.

Setelah shalat, mereka duduk di luar sejenak, memperhatikan orang-orang yang lewat. Hassan menyadari bahwa rutinitas tenang di hari Jumat ini, yang berulang selama bertahun-tahun, adalah hal yang menyatukan keluarga besar lintas generasi.

title: A Muslim's Day
english: Ahmad wakes up early, before sunrise, for Fajr prayer. The sky outside is still dark and quiet. He prays calmly, then sits for a moment to read a little Quran before checking his phone for the day's schedule.

After prayer, he eats a simple breakfast of bread and tea. Then he drives to his office in the city. He works hard through several meetings, and pauses briefly at midday for the noon prayer, Dhuhr, before continuing.

In the evening, he comes home feeling tired but genuinely satisfied with his day's work. He prays Maghrib together with his wife before dinner, and they talk quietly about their plans for the coming weekend.

Before sleeping, Ahmad reflects for a moment on his day. He notices that even on his busiest days, the five prayers give his schedule a steady rhythm, something to return to no matter how demanding work becomes.
indonesian: Ahmad bangun pagi-pagi, sebelum matahari terbit, untuk shalat Subuh. Langit di luar masih gelap dan sunyi. Ia shalat dengan tenang, lalu duduk sejenak membaca sedikit Al-Qur'an sebelum memeriksa ponselnya untuk jadwal hari itu.

Setelah shalat, ia makan sarapan sederhana berupa roti dan teh. Kemudian ia berkendara ke kantornya di kota. Ia bekerja keras melalui beberapa rapat, dan berhenti sebentar saat tengah hari untuk shalat Dzuhur sebelum melanjutkan pekerjaannya.

Di sore hari, ia pulang dengan perasaan lelah namun benar-benar puas dengan pekerjaannya hari itu. Ia shalat Maghrib bersama istrinya sebelum makan malam, dan mereka berbincang pelan tentang rencana akhir pekan mendatang.

Sebelum tidur, Ahmad merenung sejenak tentang harinya. Ia menyadari bahwa bahkan di hari-hari tersibuknya, lima waktu shalat memberi ritme yang stabil pada jadwalnya, sesuatu untuk kembali diingat betapa pun beratnya pekerjaan.

title: A Village After the Storm
english: A big storm was hitting the small village late one night. Rain was falling very hard, and strong wind was shaking the roofs of every simple house. Many families were staying awake, unable to fall asleep during the noise.

While the storm was still happening outside, the neighbors were quietly checking on each other's safety through their windows and phones. One family was cooking extra rice and warm soup to share with anyone who needed it that night.

By early morning, the storm was finally ending, and the sky was becoming calm again. Several men were checking the damaged roofs together, while others were clearing fallen branches from the main road before people left for work.

Looking back, the villagers often say that the storm actually brought them closer together as a community. They still remember how everyone worked side by side that morning, without anyone needing to be asked twice.
indonesian: Badai besar sedang melanda desa kecil itu pada suatu malam. Hujan turun sangat deras, dan angin kencang mengguncang atap setiap rumah sederhana. Banyak keluarga tetap terjaga, tidak bisa tidur karena kebisingan itu.

Saat badai masih berlangsung di luar, para tetangga diam-diam saling memeriksa keselamatan lewat jendela dan telepon. Satu keluarga sedang memasak nasi dan sup hangat lebih banyak untuk dibagikan kepada siapa pun yang membutuhkannya malam itu.

Menjelang pagi, badai akhirnya mereda, dan langit mulai kembali tenang. Beberapa pria memeriksa atap yang rusak bersama-sama, sementara yang lain membersihkan ranting yang jatuh di jalan utama sebelum orang-orang berangkat kerja.

Jika dikenang, warga desa sering berkata bahwa badai itu justru mempererat kebersamaan mereka sebagai komunitas. Mereka masih ingat bagaimana semua orang bekerja berdampingan pagi itu, tanpa perlu diminta dua kali.

title: Morning Routine
english: Every single morning, Zainab wakes up quietly before the sun rises. She prays Fajr first, then drinks a full glass of clean water before checking her work emails on her phone while the house is still silent.

After that, she makes her bed neatly and gets dressed for the day ahead. She also prepares a simple breakfast of eggs and bread for her two children before they leave for school, and packs her own lunch for work.
By seven o'clock, everyone in the house is finally ready and calm. She drops her children off before heading to her office, already thinking through the first meeting on her schedule for the morning.

Zainab always feels good when her morning starts peacefully and with order, instead of rushing around and feeling stressed like it used to happen before she built this steady routine over the past year.
indonesian: Setiap pagi, Zainab bangun dengan tenang sebelum matahari terbit. Ia shalat Subuh terlebih dahulu, lalu minum segelas penuh air bersih sebelum memeriksa email kerjanya di ponsel saat rumah masih sunyi.

Setelah itu, ia merapikan tempat tidurnya dengan rapi dan berpakaian untuk memulai harinya. Ia juga menyiapkan sarapan sederhana berupa telur dan roti untuk kedua anaknya sebelum berangkat sekolah, sekaligus menyiapkan bekal makan siangnya sendiri untuk kerja.
Pada pukul tujuh, semua orang di rumah akhirnya siap dan tenang. Ia mengantar anak-anaknya sebelum berangkat ke kantor, sambil sudah memikirkan rapat pertama dalam jadwalnya pagi itu.

Zainab selalu merasa senang ketika paginya dimulai dengan damai dan teratur, alih-alih terburu-buru dan merasa stres seperti yang biasa terjadi sebelum ia membangun rutinitas yang stabil ini selama setahun terakhir.

title: Cleaning the House
english: It is Saturday morning, so the whole family decides to clean the house together, just like every week. Father sweeps the floor carefully while Mother washes the dishes left from a busy week of work and school.

The children clean their own small rooms and put their belongings away neatly. Everyone in the family has a task to complete, so nobody has to work alone or feel exhausted doing everything by themselves.
After about two hours of steady work, the house looks fresh, clean, and bright again. They all sit together in the living room, drink warm tea, and talk about small plans for the rest of the weekend.
The parents have learned over the years that dividing housework fairly, rather than leaving it all to one person, keeps both the home and the relationships inside it far more peaceful and balanced.
indonesian: Hari ini Sabtu pagi, jadi seluruh keluarga memutuskan membersihkan rumah bersama-sama, seperti setiap minggunya. Ayah menyapu lantai dengan teliti sementara Ibu mencuci piring yang tersisa dari minggu yang sibuk dengan kerja dan sekolah.

Anak-anak membersihkan kamar kecil mereka masing-masing dan merapikan barang-barang mereka. Setiap orang di keluarga itu punya tugas untuk diselesaikan, jadi tidak ada yang bekerja sendirian atau merasa kelelahan mengerjakan semuanya sendiri.

Setelah sekitar dua jam bekerja dengan teratur, rumah terlihat segar, bersih, dan cerah kembali. Mereka semua duduk bersama di ruang tamu, minum teh hangat, dan membicarakan rencana kecil untuk sisa akhir pekan.

Para orang tua telah belajar selama bertahun-tahun bahwa membagi pekerjaan rumah secara adil, alih-alih membebankan semuanya pada satu orang, membuat rumah dan hubungan di dalamnya jauh lebih tenang dan seimbang.

title: A Simple Dinner
english: After Maghrib prayer, the whole family sits together around the table for dinner. Tonight the food is simple: warm rice, some fresh vegetables, and a small piece of grilled fish that Mother prepared after coming home from work.

"Bismillah," Father says quietly before everyone starts eating together. As they eat, everyone talks about their day. Mother mentions a difficult client at the office, and the children share stories from school.

Even a simple meal, eaten together as a family after a long day, feels genuinely special and grounding. Nobody rushes to finish; instead, they take their time and enjoy each other's company at the table.
By the time the plates are cleared, the whole family feels calmer than they did an hour earlier. They realize that a shared dinner, however simple, does far more for a family than the food itself.
indonesian: Setelah shalat Maghrib, seluruh keluarga duduk bersama mengelilingi meja untuk makan malam. Malam ini makanannya sederhana: nasi hangat, beberapa sayuran segar, dan sepotong kecil ikan bakar yang disiapkan Ibu setelah pulang kerja.

"Bismillah," kata Ayah pelan sebelum semua orang mulai makan bersama. Sambil makan, semua orang bercerita tentang harinya. Ibu menyebutkan klien yang sulit di kantor, dan anak-anak berbagi cerita dari sekolah.

Bahkan makanan sederhana, dimakan bersama sebagai keluarga setelah hari yang panjang, terasa benar-benar istimewa dan menenangkan. Tidak ada yang terburu-buru menghabiskan makanan; sebaliknya, mereka meluangkan waktu dan menikmati kebersamaan di meja makan.

Saat piring-piring sudah dibereskan, seluruh keluarga merasa lebih tenang dibanding satu jam sebelumnya. Mereka menyadari bahwa makan malam bersama, sesederhana apa pun, memberi jauh lebih banyak bagi keluarga daripada sekadar makanan itu sendiri.

title: Grocery Shopping for the Week
english: Every Saturday morning, Halim goes to the market. He buys food for the whole week. He started this habit because daily shopping took too much of his free time.
The night before, Halim writes a list. He and his wife make simple meal plans together. The list helps him buy only what they need.
At the market, Halim checks the vegetables and fish. His mother taught him to do this years ago. He presses tomatoes gently and smells the fish before he buys it.
The trip takes about one hour. But it saves time and money on busy weekdays. Before Monday, the kitchen already has the food they need.
At first, Halim thought the habit was boring. Now he enjoys the quiet market morning. He also talks for a short time with sellers he knows.
indonesian: Setiap Sabtu pagi, Halim pergi ke pasar. Ia membeli makanan untuk satu minggu. Ia memulai kebiasaan ini karena belanja setiap hari memakai terlalu banyak waktu luangnya.
Malam sebelumnya, Halim menulis daftar. Ia dan istrinya membuat rencana makan sederhana bersama. Daftar itu membantunya membeli hanya barang yang mereka perlukan.
Di pasar, Halim memeriksa sayur dan ikan. Ibunya mengajarkan hal ini bertahun-tahun lalu. Ia menekan tomat dengan lembut dan mencium ikan sebelum membelinya.
Perjalanan itu memakan waktu sekitar satu jam. Tetapi kebiasaan itu menghemat waktu dan uang saat hari kerja sibuk. Sebelum Senin, dapur sudah memiliki makanan yang mereka perlukan.
Awalnya, Halim merasa kebiasaan ini membosankan. Sekarang ia menikmati pagi pasar yang tenang. Ia juga berbicara sebentar dengan penjual yang ia kenal.
